This map ranks countries by avocado production in 2024. Mexico produces more than any other nation by a wide margin — and one Mexican state grows most of it, under the watch of drug cartels who tax the fruit like a customs post.

a thread 🧵🗺️

Data: Our World in Data (CC BY)
1/ Michoacán state produced roughly 2.25 million tonnes of avocados in 2023 — about 76% of Mexico's entire national output, and enough on its own to be one of the largest sources on this whole map.
2/ Mexico supplies around 82% of the avocados eaten in the United States. Michoacán calls itself the avocado capital of the world, and its export trade is worth an estimated $2.5 billion a year.
3/ That much cash draws cartels. Producers in Michoacán have described paying roughly 1 peso per kilo exported in protection money — one farm alone said this added up to over $5,000 a day.

4/ The US has suspended Mexican avocado inspections more than once after inspectors were threatened, most notably in February 2022, briefly halting imports and rattling supply right before Super Bowl weekend.

5/ Colombia, Peru, the Dominican Republic, and Indonesia round out the map's next tier of producers — real suppliers, but none close to matching Michoacán's single-state output.
